name: sketched_bend_raises_half_the_sheet_metal
why: ENTRY GP18, the fifth operation. A flat sheet-metal part 100 x 40 x 2 (R 2), bent at 90 degrees along a cross line at x = 50 on the top face. Measured with the bench probe (`prova0089 piega`) before writing it: volume unchanged, and the bounding box that matches the calculation — 46 of flat (50 - R - T), the bend of 4.712, and the rest (49.288) that rises from y = 2. A bend does not add sheet metal, it moves it: the flat pattern stays 100.

expect.tolerance_why: in y: from -2 to R + (100 - (50 - R - T) - pi/2 * (R + K T)) = 51.288. The fixed side is the one at x < 50: it is chosen by SOLIDWORKS, and that is why the expectation is on the whole bounding box
a bend does not add sheet metal
flattened, the sheet metal of before comes back
